title: Scannex Training Programme
description: A staged Scannex training pathway. Each published learning intervention is the main learning experience, with its e-book retained as a supporting reference.
audience: Scannex operators, supervisors, and training coordinators who need stable Thinkific lesson URLs for testing and rollout.
integrationNotes: Use the learning-intervention URL as the main link for each published unit.
Keep the e-book available as an on-demand reference within that same unit.
Units without a published learning intervention remain e-book-only until their iSpring package is added.
